characterization: CHARACTERIZATION — records CURRENT behaviour, not desired behaviour

pack-action-cap.reason: expects 5 queued entries; planner emits 3 (E3 Move, E1 Move, E2 Defend) because no wolf is adjacent on grid 16 so Attack is never planned.

pack-attack-non-focus-adjacent.reason: hard-coded positions assume a small grid; on grid 16 the flank wolf is not adjacent to anyone so no Attack is planned (passes at grid 8 and 10).

pack-multi-tick.reason: expects enemy.row > 0 after the turn; E1 only gets Defend (stale 3-wolf default spacing), so it stays at row 0.

pack-one-enemy.reason: expects every entry from the unit at (0,4); queue is M@0,4 M@0,4 D@0,7, so the unit at (0,7) appears (stale default spawn layout).
